title: Compare MoE routing strategies
prompt: Explain the trade-offs between top-1 and top-2 expert routing in a mixture-of-experts layer, and how the auxiliary load-balancing loss prevents expert collapse. Use a concrete example with 8 experts and walk through the routing of a single token.
